issues.description: The UML/problem specification declares numberOfInscribedStudents as type int, but the solution implementation declares the attribute as long. This mismatch between the specification and the solution will confuse students about the intended type and may lead to incorrect implementations or unexpected casting issues.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the attribute type consistent with the UML: change numberOfInscribedStudents to int in the solution (and update its getter/setter and constructor parameter accordingly). Alternatively, if large values are required, update the problem statement/UML to specify long and ensure all method signatures and return types reflect long.

issues.description: The UML specifies getTotalNumberOfStudents() returns an int, but the solution's implementation of this method sums a long attribute (numberOfInscribedStudents) and an int, creating a long expression while the method is declared to return int. This leads to a type mismatch and a compile error (lossy conversion from long to int).
issues.suggestedFix: Align types so the return type and summed operands match. Either: (a) change numberOfInscribedStudents to int throughout the solution so getTotalNumberOfStudents() can safely return int, or (b) change getTotalNumberOfStudents() to return long (and update the UML/problem statement accordingly) if large values must be supported.

issues.description: The constructor in the solution accepts a long parameter for numberOfInscribedStudents while the UML and problem description expect an int parameter in the specified attribute order. This constructor parameter type mismatch deviates from the specification and may confuse students implementing the constructor according to the UML.
issues.suggestedFix: Adjust the constructor parameter type to match the UML: change the constructor signature to accept an int for numberOfInscribedStudents (and assign to an int field). If the design intentionally requires a long, update the problem statement/UML to list long and ensure all related method signatures and documentation are updated accordingly.
